answer: The relic assignment is published and summit records each panel. Shards are assigned from the beacon graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1602 identities would post 3598 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
